findings.evidence: Hosts restates which skill directories Claude Code, opencode, pi, Codex and Cursor already read, then says nothing extra is linked for Codex and Cursor.
findings.fix: Delete the Hosts section. Keep only a non-obvious install gap if one still changes what the agent must do.

findings.evidence: ## Call it is one line that only says to read the request shape, so the procedure never states how to choose noul, choice, score or shorthand.
findings.fix: Replace that heading with a four-row decision: yes/no is noul, named options are choice, ordered levels are score, and criterion-plus-evidence is shorthand, then point at reference.md.

findings.evidence: Red Flags lists three phrases and defers the hard-won reasons to reference.md, so the always-loaded body has the triggers without the why.
findings.fix: Put one why clause on each phrase in SKILL.md, for example that a configured key, the ladder's next rung, and a relayed standing instruction are not consent.

findings.evidence: Required reading lists four external docs unconditionally, while the skill's own reference.md and backends are gated only by the first call or by choice, score or receipt.
findings.fix: Drop the four external links from the always-loaded body. Keep the conditional reads of reference.md and backends/<selected>.md, and name the external page only inside the backend note that needs it.

findings.evidence: The TypeSafe key lookup lists seven sources, including a transitional ~/.mycreds parse, with no single default the agent should use.
findings.fix: State one default, the environment variable TYPESAFE_API_KEY, and move the file fallbacks and the transitional ~/.mycreds line to a single sentence marked transitional.

findings.evidence: Output assertions prescribe the request the agent must build, such as exactly one noul item and a criteria map of exactly three options, rather than a verifiable property of the answer.
findings.fix: Rewrite each assertion around the observable result: value-free evidence, the agent's own decision when needs_fallback is set, and no remote call before consent. Keep the request shape in expected_output.

findings.evidence: eval_cases.py is a runnable script with no --help; it reads --calibrate and --record by scanning sys.argv.
findings.fix: Add an argparse parser whose --help names the default 32-case run, --record PATH and --calibrate PATH, and print the metrics JSON on stdout.

findings.evidence: The first instruction is to run python3 -B scripts/jev_review.py --probe, but reference.md says GSD_PATH_JEV must be exactly 1 or the client returns disabled, and the example is the only place that sets it.
findings.fix: Put GSD_PATH_JEV=1 and a positive GSD_PATH_JEV_TIMEOUT_SECONDS on the probe command in Pick the backend, and say a disabled status means the switch is off, not that no backend exists.

findings.evidence: The endpoint section says one question per call because batch is false, while Status says batch is verified-live and the client still sends one item per call.
findings.fix: Delete the verified-live batch claim from Status. Say the row is one item per call, and that a batch cell does not mean the client will send a batch.
